# Weekpad / 위크패드

> A free, ad-free weekly spending pad with no account. Give each category
> (groceries, coffee, transit) a small weekly budget, log what you spend, and
> watch the progress bar and remaining amount. A fresh week starts on its own
> every Monday (or Sunday) and past weeks stay browsable.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://weekpad.try-dabble.com/
Categories, expenses and preferences stay in this browser on this device. No
accounts, no bank linking, no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no in-app
purchases. Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones; export
CSV for a spreadsheet.

This is NOT a monthly budgeting suite, NOT a bank aggregator and NOT a currency
converter. The currency setting only changes the symbol in front of the numbers.

- [Home](https://weekpad.try-dabble.com/): The weekly pad
- [Privacy](https://weekpad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

## Features

- Weekly planned amount per category; add, edit, archive, delete
- Quick expense entry: amount, category, optional note, date within the week
- Progress bar, spent and remaining per category; overspend shown in red
- Week navigator (previous / this week / next) and an automatic new week on the boundary
- Recurring categories carry the same weekly budget forward; one-off categories apply to one week
- Currency symbol preference ($, ₩, ¥, €, and more), display only
- JSON export / import and CSV export of expenses
- Text size A / A+ / A++
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
